headline: Rent increase applications for 439 Congress St, 117 Preble St, 90 Pine St, and 131 Sherman St, plus a 91 State St completeness check.
summary: The agenda lists rent increase applications for 439 Congress St, 117 Preble St, 90 Pine St, and 131 Sherman St. It also includes a completeness check for 91 State St and a revision to Article XI of the rules of procedure.
items: News release on settlement agreement between the City, Trelawny Tenants Union, and a landlord
Approval of findings of fact and conclusions of law
Rent increase application for 439 Congress St, all 81 units, for increased housing service costs (Metropolitan Apartments LLC; CBL 027-B-004-001)
Rent Board Rules of Procedure, Article XI revision
Public comment on rent increase application for 117 Preble St, all 56 units, for increased housing service costs (Schlotterbeck Block LLC; CBL 033-E-001-001)
Public comment on rent increase application for 90 Pine St, all 4 units, for increased housing service costs (90 Pine Street Apartments LLC; CBL 056-A-003-001)
Public comment on rent increase application for 131 Sherman St, all 6 units, for increased housing service costs (Sherman Street Properties, LLC; CBL 048-C-018-001)
Completeness check for rent increase application for 91 State St, all 10 units (91 State Street LLC; CBL 045-B-023-001)
